purpose: Check whether removing absolute sensor levels preserves DI and risk information; not a new independent test or replacement
data: Existing controlled_dataset_v2 train main scenes only; preserve censored DI labels, no invented endpoints or extra synthetic DI labels
split_rule: Chronological train background blocks [0,a), evaluate [a,b); entire scene/background kept together; all rows before July 2022
baseline: 125 features in original order: current, mean last24, current minus first of last24, mean last96, current minus first of last96; all include current point
candidate: 50 features: columns 50:75 and 100:125 of the same baseline matrix; endpoint differences span 23 and 95 sample intervals (5.75 and 23.75 h)
models: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=10) for each representation; one fit per fold, no search; median of sampled fit DI is an additional descriptive constant reference
prediction: Raw DI saved, clip to [0,1]; risk I if >=0.85, II if >=0.65, III if >=0.4, else IV; no smoothing or new thresholds

metrics.primary: Scene mean absolute error averaged equally across three folds
metrics.additional: Point MAE, bias, clipping fraction, background MAE, risk accuracy, macro F1, over/under risk fractions, per-class recall; report all folds
metrics.strata: Existing nominal 12/24/48/72 h durations, groups and curve exponents; 48/72 h are slow only relative to this existing main experiment
metrics.pre_injection: step<=onset, DI_ref=1 by construction, deduplicate source rows separately within each fold/model; check duplicate predictions agree
metrics.no_independent_sample_claim: Scenes share source backgrounds; report counts, no point-based significance test

mechanism_probe: For each fold, add training-scale constant offsets to all time steps of a valid evaluation window; check algebraic invariance of difference features in float64, not a realistic new fault test. Never use onset, label, duration, timestamp, source key or block ID as model input

advance_rule.purpose: Conservative auxiliary screen using the prior 1 percentage point recall tolerance; not a paper or project acceptance target
all_required: Mean fold scene MAE strictly lower and every fold scene MAE no higher than baseline
Pooled recall of each reference risk class no more than 0.01 below baseline
Every fold reference-IV recall no more than 0.01 below baseline
Each existing 48 h and 72 h fold/stratum scene MAE no higher than baseline with support present
Mean fold absolute pre-injection mean bias no higher than baseline
advance_rule.stop: If any fails or support is absent, do not advance; preserve negative results and do not change features, alpha, risk boundaries or evaluation data

limitations: Original injection amplitudes used Jan-Jun statistics; fitting is forward but generation is not fully forward
These backgrounds were used during research; post-test motivation prevents new independent-test claims
Construction labels describe injected damage, not verified field health
Constant-offset invariance alone does not establish useful health-state identifiability
No July-December observation parsing, scoring or tuning; original frozen artifacts unchanged
